rationale: Section 5 of the wording does not pay for "belongings left unattended," which it defines as out of your sight and out of your reach in a place the public can get to, and the manual's interpretation note confirms that a bag on a train luggage rack while the customer is on the platform is unattended. Ms Richards stepped off the train and was away about ten minutes, so every item in the valise falls under that exclusion and the payout is $0 (manual §6, step 1). Separately, the $1,900 claim for the manuscript and notebooks would in any event be limited to the physical paper under the "value of information" exclusion, and the drive to the physical drive.
